module_summary: 64-bit UDP/IP stack: an IP stack instance handles Ethernet/ARP, a protocol classifier with per-frame select registers routes received IP frames to the UDP block or external IP port, and an arbitrated mux merges UDP and external IP transmit frames.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Incoming Ethernet frame header valid into the IP stack.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Incoming 64-bit Ethernet payload into the IP stack.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Outgoing Ethernet frame header valid from the IP stack.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Outgoing 64-bit Ethernet payload from the IP stack.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: UDP transmit header valid into the UDP block.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: UDP transmit payload into the UDP block.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Received UDP header valid from the UDP block.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received UDP payload from the UDP block.

anchors.name: s_select_udp_reg
anchors.why: Per-frame route register steering received IP payload valid/ready to UDP block.

anchors.name: s_select_ip_reg
anchors.why: Per-frame route register steering received IP payload to external IP output.

anchors.name: s_select_udp
anchors.why: Decodes ip_protocol==0x11 to classify received IP headers as UDP.

anchors.name: ip_rx_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Received IP header valid from IP stack, split to UDP or external IP.

anchors.name: ip_rx_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received IP payload broadcast to UDP and external IP outputs.

anchors.name: ip_rx_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Ready muxed from selected destination back to IP stack.

anchors.name: ip_rx_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready muxed from UDP or external IP sink by classifier.

anchors.name: udp_rx_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: IP payload valid gated by UDP select into UDP block.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: External IP transmit header valid into the arbiter mux.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: External IP transmit payload into the arbiter mux.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Non-UDP received IP header valid output, gated by s_select_ip.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Non-UDP received IP payload output.

anchors.name: ip_tx_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Arbitrated IP transmit header valid into IP stack.

anchors.name: ip_tx_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Arbitrated IP transmit payload into IP stack.

anchors.name: udp_tx_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: UDP block's encapsulated IP header valid into arbiter input 0.

anchors.name: local_ip
anchors.why: Local IP address configuration for IP/ARP stack.

anchors.name: local_mac
anchors.why: Local MAC address configuration for IP/ARP stack.

anchors.name: gateway_ip
anchors.why: Gateway IP used for ARP next-hop resolution.

anchors.name: clear_arp_cache
anchors.why: Command to clear the ARP cache in the IP stack.

anchors.name: ip_tx_error_arp_failed
anchors.why: IP transmit ARP resolution failure status.

anchors.name: ip_rx_busy
anchors.why: IP receive busy status from IP stack.

anchors.name: udp_rx_busy
anchors.why: UDP receive busy status from UDP block.

groups.name: ip_stack
groups.description: 64-bit IPv4 stack with ARP converting between Ethernet frames and IP frames.

groups.name: rx_protocol_classifier
groups.description: Routes received IP frames to UDP block or external IP port by protocol field.

groups.name: udp_block
groups.description: UDP framer/deparser between UDP frames and IP frames with checksum generation.

groups.name: tx_ip_arbiter
groups.description: Arbitrated mux merging UDP-generated and external IP transmit frames into IP stack.
